title: ARM Architecture Reference Manual ARMv8, for ARMv8-A architecture profile
identity_verification: Internal title, publisher/copyright and DDI0487B.a page identifiers inspected; relevant MVFR2 definition pages recorded in the qualification evidence.
integrity_limit: This is an academic mirror of the Arm-authored primary manual. Byte identity to a current Arm-hosted copy is unknown; the retrieved PDF is retained unchanged. Current manufacturer FP TRMs independently confirm the full-profile endpoints.
use: MVFR1 SIMDFMAC and MVFR2 FPMisc/SIMDMisc capability definitions; instruction/permission sequencing is checked against pinned ASL and independent execution.
revision_boundary: The 2017 manual is used for these stable register-field definitions, not as a substitute for the pinned 2025-12 pseudocode for newer controls/features.
size_justification: The complete primary manual is needed across the original A32 profile, mixed-width control and checkpoint/SMP investigations; retaining original page numbering, context and copyright notices avoids silently rewriting or omitting requirements. No source pages were changed.
copyright: Original Arm copyright and distribution notices retained in the retrieved PDF.
